worldcombat.skill.aromaticmist.summary: Lays a lingering fragrant cloud at a chosen spot that wraps allies inside it and raises their Sp. Def. The aroma clings for a moment after leaving the cloud, so walking around it avoids the effect.
worldcombat.skill.aromaticmist.use.0: Lay a fragrant cloud at a doorway allies are holding
worldcombat.skill.aromaticmist.use.1: Top up a brawling ally's Sp. Def
worldcombat.skill.aromaticmist.use.2: Keep a healer or back line wrapped in the aroma
worldcombat.skill.aromaticmist.descripti: The mist raises the Sp. Def of allies inside by %1$s stages; the aroma keeps refreshing while they stay in the cloud, clings for about %2$s s after they leave, and the Sp. Def is taken back when the aroma ends or is cleared.
The cloud spreads from the chosen point with a %1$s-block radius and lingers in the world for about %2$s s.
Send range %1$s blocks; telegraph %2$s, recovery %3$s, cooldown %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.aromaticmist.bouquet.r: Rich aroma: the scent lingers longer but the cloud is smaller; it holds tight and lasts.
worldcombat.skill.aromaticmist.bouquet.w: Wide aroma: a larger cloud but a shorter lingering scent; it spreads wide and fades fast.
worldcombat.skill.aromaticmist.timing: Ground-targeted move, range %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of telegraph it costs %4$s PP to fire, then %3$s s recovery and %5$s s cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.aromaticmist.preferenc: Rich aroma: lingering scent x1.3, radius x0.8. Wide aroma: radius x1.25, lingering scent x0.75. Each has its own opening.
Both the threat and the ally must be within this distance to send the aroma; larger runs farther to lay a cloud.
When on, the companion will leave its post to lay a fragrant cloud even under a hold order.
